paragraphs.zh: Title: PROCESS FOR PREPARATION OF MESOTRIONE AND ITS INTERMEDIATES
paragraphs.en: Title: PROCESS FOR PREPARATION OF MESOTRIONE AND ITS INTERMEDIATES
paragraphs.notes: Below the full-width rule that closes the bibliographic block. 'Title:' is bold, the title itself is in roman capitals. Only the English title is printed; there is no second-language title on this page.

paragraphs.zh: Abstract: The present disclosure provides a new and improved process for preparation of intermediate compounds and synthesis of mesotrione therefrom. The present disclosure provides an economical, efficient and eco-friendly process for preparation of mesotrione.
paragraphs.en: Abstract: The present disclosure provides a new and improved process for preparation of intermediate compounds and synthesis of mesotrione therefrom. The present disclosure provides an economical, efficient and eco-friendly process for preparation of mesotrione.
paragraphs.notes: Two sentences, set full width across the foot of the page. No abstract drawing or figure accompanies it. The hyphen in 'eco-friendly' is printed. The abstract names no reagent, no intermediate and no yield.
